# Helpful functions 

as_dropbox_download <- function(url) {
  
  if (is.na(url) || url == "") {
    return(url)
  }
  
  if (str_detect(url, "dl=0")) {
    return(
      str_replace(
        url,
        "dl=0",
        "dl=1"
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (!str_detect(url, "dl=1")) {
    
    separator <- ifelse(
      str_detect(url, "\\?"),
      "&",
      "?"
    )
    
    return(
      paste0(
        url,
        separator,
        "dl=1"
      )
    )
  }
  
  url
}


blank_if_missing <- function(x) {
  
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  
  x
}


find_col <- function(
    df,
    candidates,
    required = TRUE
) {
  
  hit <- candidates[
    candidates %in% names(df)
  ]
  
  if (length(hit) > 0) {
    return(hit[[1]])
  }
  
  if (required) {
    
    stop(
      "None of these expected columns were found: ",
      paste(
        candidates,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  NA_character_
}


fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  
  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    is.na(x)
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  formatC(
    round(
      as.numeric(x),
      1
    ),
    format = "f",
    digits = 1
  )
}


fmt_dollars <- function(x) {
  
  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    is.na(x)
  ) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  formatC(
    round(as.numeric(x) / 100) * 100,
    format = "f",
    big.mark = ",",
    digits = 0
  )
}


sentence_if_complete <- function(
    values,
    text
) {
  
  if (any(is.na(values))) {
    return("")
  }
  
  text
}

# Geography list from NUCLEUS

geo_id_col <- find_col(
  places_raw,
  c(
    "GEO_ID",
    "geo_id",
    "Geo_ID"
  )
)


geo_label_col <- find_col(
  places_raw,
  c(
    "GEO_LABEL",
    "Place",
    "PLACE_NAME",
    "Geography"
  )
)


full_name_col <- find_col(
  places_raw,
  c(
    "Full Census Name",
    "Full_Place_Name",
    "FULL_PLACE_NAME"
  ),
  required = FALSE
)


places <- places_raw %>%
  
  transmute(
    
    GEO_ID =
      as.character(
        .data[[geo_id_col]]
      ),
    
    GEO_LABEL =
      as.character(
        .data[[geo_label_col]]
      ),
    
    FULL_PLACE_NAME =
      if (!is.na(full_name_col)) {
        
        as.character(
          .data[[full_name_col]]
        )
        
      } else {
        
        as.character(
          .data[[geo_label_col]]
        )
        
      }
    
  ) %>%
  
  filter(
    !is.na(GEO_ID),
    GEO_ID != "",
    !is.na(GEO_LABEL),
    GEO_LABEL != ""
  ) %>%
  
  distinct(
    GEO_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )



# Generate first sentence from City Descriptions 

places_with_opening <- places %>%
  
  mutate(
    OPENING_DESCRIPTION = ""
  )


if (!is.null(city_descriptions)) {
  
  
  # Geography ID, if available
  desc_geo_id_col <- find_col(
    city_descriptions,
    c(
      "GEO_ID",
      "geo_id",
      "Geo_ID",
      "Geography_ID"
    ),
    required = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # Geography/place-name column
  # "CDP" is the field used in the City Descriptions workbook
  desc_geo_label_col <- find_col(
    city_descriptions,
    c(
      "CDP",
      "GEO_LABEL",
      "GEO_LABEL (adjusted)",
      "Place",
      "PLACE_NAME",
      "Geography"
    ),
    required = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # Description column
  # "1st Sentence" is the field used in the City Descriptions workbook.
  # "1st.Sentence" is included as a fallback in case check.names
  # mangles the header on some future read (e.g. a different reader
  # function, or a re-saved copy of the workbook).
  desc_text_col <- find_col(
    city_descriptions,
    c(
      "1st Sentence",
      "1st.Sentence",
      "First_Sentence",
      "FIRST_SENTENCE",
      "Sentence_1",
      "Opening_Description",
      "Description",
      "CITY_DESCRIPTION"
    ),
    required = FALSE
  )
  
  
  
  # Use GEO_ID when it exists in the descriptions file
  
  if (
    !is.na(desc_text_col) &&
    !is.na(desc_geo_id_col)
  ) {
    
    description_lookup <-
      city_descriptions %>%
      
      transmute(
        
        GEO_ID =
          as.character(
            .data[[desc_geo_id_col]]
          ),
        
        OPENING_DESCRIPTION =
          blank_if_missing(
            .data[[desc_text_col]]
          )
        
      ) %>%
      
      distinct(
        GEO_ID,
        .keep_all = TRUE
      )
    
    
    places_with_opening <-
      places %>%
      
      left_join(
        description_lookup,
        by = "GEO_ID"
      ) %>%
      
      mutate(
        OPENING_DESCRIPTION =
          blank_if_missing(
            OPENING_DESCRIPTION
          )
      )
    
    
    # Otherwise match using place/CDP name
    
  } else if (
    !is.na(desc_text_col) &&
    !is.na(desc_geo_label_col)
  ) {
    
    description_lookup <-
      city_descriptions %>%
      
      transmute(
        
        GEO_LABEL =
          as.character(
            .data[[desc_geo_label_col]]
          ) %>%
          str_remove(",\\s*California\\s*$") %>%
          str_remove("\\s+(CDP|city|town)\\s*$") %>%
          str_trim(),
        
        OPENING_DESCRIPTION =
          blank_if_missing(
            .data[[desc_text_col]]
          )
        
      ) %>%
      
      # Manual name fixes for CDPs that don't line up with NUCLEUS labels
      mutate(
        GEO_LABEL =
          recode(
            GEO_LABEL,
            "Vandenberg SFB" = "Vandenberg Space Force Base"
          )
      ) %>%
      
      distinct(
        GEO_LABEL,
        .keep_all = TRUE
      )
    
    
    places_with_opening <-
      places %>%
      
      left_join(
        description_lookup,
        by = "GEO_LABEL"
      ) %>%
      
      mutate(
        OPENING_DESCRIPTION =
          blank_if_missing(
            OPENING_DESCRIPTION
          )
      )
    
    
  } else {
    
    warning(
      paste0(
        "City Descriptions does not contain ",
        "a recognizable geography field ",
        "and description field. ",
        "Opening descriptions were left blank."
      )
    )
    
  }
  
}

# Numeric data 

summary_place <-

# Comparison fields 

earnings_q <- quantile(
  
  summary_place[[
    vars$median_personal_earnings
  ]],
  
  probs = c(
    0.25,
    0.75
  ),
  
  na.rm = TRUE
)


native_place_sd <- sd(
  
  summary_place[[
    vars$native
  ]],
  
  na.rm = TRUE
)


county_native <-
  county_summary[[
    county_vars$native
  ]][[1]]



summary_place <-
  summary_place %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    earnings_comparison =
      case_when(
        
        is.na(
          .data[[
            vars$median_personal_earnings
          ]]
        ) ~ NA_character_,
        
        
        .data[[
          vars$median_personal_earnings
        ]] ==
          min(
            .data[[
              vars$median_personal_earnings
            ]],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) ~
          "the lowest among Santa Barbara County places",
        
        
        .data[[
          vars$median_personal_earnings
        ]] ==
          max(
            .data[[
              vars$median_personal_earnings
            ]],
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) ~
          "the highest among Santa Barbara County places",
        
        
        .data[[
          vars$median_personal_earnings
        ]] <=
          earnings_q[[1]] ~
          "placing it in the bottom quarter countywide",
        
        
        .data[[
          vars$median_personal_earnings
        ]] >=
          earnings_q[[2]] ~
          "placing it in the top quarter countywide",
        
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
        
      ),
    
    
    native_comparison =
      case_when(
        
        is.na(
          .data[[
            vars$native
          ]]
        ) ~
          NA_character_,
        
        
        .data[[
          vars$native
        ]] >
          county_native +
          native_place_sd ~
          "A higher-than-average ",
        
        
        .data[[
          vars$native
        ]] <
          county_native -
          native_place_sd ~
          "A lower-than-average ",
        
        
        TRUE ~
          NA_character_
        
      )
    
  )



# Life expectancy comparisons

if (has_life_expectancy) {
  
  life_q <- quantile(
    
    summary_place[[
      life_expectancy_place_var
    ]],
    
    probs = c(
      0.25,
      0.75
    ),
    
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  
  summary_place <-
    summary_place %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      life_expectancy_comparison =
        case_when(
          
          is.na(
            .data[[
              life_expectancy_place_var
            ]]
          ) ~
            NA_character_,
          
          
          .data[[
            life_expectancy_place_var
          ]] ==
            min(
              .data[[
                life_expectancy_place_var
              ]],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ) ~
            "the shortest",
          
          
          .data[[
            life_expectancy_place_var
          ]] ==
            max(
              .data[[
                life_expectancy_place_var
              ]],
              na.rm = TRUE
            ) ~
            "the longest",
          
          
          .data[[
            life_expectancy_place_var
          ]] <=
            life_q[[1]] ~
            "in the bottom quarter of life expectancies",
          
          
          .data[[
            life_expectancy_place_var
          ]] >=
            life_q[[2]] ~
            "in the top quarter of life expectancies",
          
          
          TRUE ~
            NA_character_
          
        )
      
    )
  
}



# Generate full paragraph 

# Generate full paragraph 

generate_place_summary <- function(
    this_geo_id
) {
  
  x <-
    summary_place %>%
    
    filter(
      GEO_ID == this_geo_id
    ) %>%
    
    slice(1)
  
  
  if (nrow(x) == 0) {
    
    return(
      
      tibble(
        
        GEO_ID =
          this_geo_id,
        
        GEO_LABEL =
          "",
        
        FULL_PLACE_NAME =
          "",
        
        OPENING_DESCRIPTION =
          "",
        
        Paragraph_Description =
          ""
        
      )
      
    )
    
  }
  
  
  # Opening description
  
  opening <-
    blank_if_missing(
      x$OPENING_DESCRIPTION[[1]]
    ) %>%
    
    str_trim()
  
  
  opening_text <-
    if (opening == "") {
      
      ""
      
    } else {
      
      paste0(
        opening,
        " "
      )
      
    }
  
  
  
  # Life expectancy sentence
  
  life_sentence <- ""
  
  
  if (has_life_expectancy) {
    
    life_value <-
      x[[
        life_expectancy_place_var
      ]][[1]]
    
    
    life_compare <-
      x$life_expectancy_comparison[[1]]
    
    
    if (!is.na(life_value)) {
      
      life_sentence <-
        paste0(
          
          "Residents live ",
          fmt_pct(
            life_value
          ),
          " years on average",
          
          if (!is.na(life_compare)) {
            
            paste0(
              ", which is ",
              life_compare,
              " in the county. "
            )
            
          } else {
            
            ". "
            
          }
          
        )
      
    }
    
  }
  
  
  
  # Education sentence
  
  education_sentence <-
    sentence_if_complete(
      
      c(
        
        x[[
          vars$at_least_hs
        ]][[1]],
        
        x[[
          vars$at_least_bachelors
        ]][[1]]
        
      ),
      
      paste0(
        
        "In terms of educational attainment, ",
        
        fmt_pct(
          x[[
            vars$at_least_hs
          ]][[1]]
        ),
        
        " percent of adults have at least a high school diploma and ",
        
        fmt_pct(
          x[[
            vars$at_least_bachelors
          ]][[1]]
        ),
        
        " percent hold at least a bachelor's degree. "
        
      )
      
    )
  
  
  
  # Earnings sentence
  
  earnings_value <-
    x[[
      vars$median_personal_earnings
    ]][[1]]
  
  
  earnings_compare <-
    x$earnings_comparison[[1]]
  
  
  earnings_sentence <-
    if (is.na(earnings_value)) {
      
      ""
      
    } else {
      
      paste0(
        
        "Median personal earnings are $",
        
        fmt_dollars(
          earnings_value
        ),
        
        if (!is.na(earnings_compare)) {
          
          paste0(
            ", ",
            earnings_compare,
            ". "
          )
          
        } else {
          
          ". "
          
        }
        
      )
      
    }
  
  
  
  # Race/ethnicity sentence
  
  race_values <- c(
    
    x[[
      vars$asian
    ]][[1]],
    
    x[[
      vars$black
    ]][[1]],
    
    x[[
      vars$latino
    ]][[1]],
    
    x[[
      vars$white
    ]][[1]]
    
  )
  
  
  race_sentence <-
    sentence_if_complete(
      
      race_values,
      
      paste0(
        
        "In this area, ",
        
        fmt_pct(
          x[[
            vars$asian
          ]][[1]]
        ),
        
        " percent of residents are Asian, ",
        
        fmt_pct(
          x[[
            vars$black
          ]][[1]]
        ),
        
        " percent are Black, ",
        
        fmt_pct(
          x[[
            vars$latino
          ]][[1]]
        ),
        
        " percent are Latino, and ",
        
        fmt_pct(
          x[[
            vars$white
          ]][[1]]
        ),
        
        " percent are white. "
        
      )
      
    )
  
  
  
  # US-born sentence
  
  native_value <-
    x[[
      vars$native
    ]][[1]]
  
  
  native_compare <-
    x$native_comparison[[1]]
  
  
  native_sentence <-
    if (
      is.na(native_value) ||
      is.na(native_compare)
    ) {
      
      ""
      
    } else {
      
      paste0(
        
        native_compare,
        
        fmt_pct(
          native_value
        ),
        
        " percent of residents were born in the US."
        
      )
      
    }
  
  
  
  # Combine sentences
  
  data_unavailable_note <-
    "This area's population is too small to present a summary of the demographic data."
  
  
  has_any_stats <-
    any(
      life_sentence != "",
      education_sentence != "",
      earnings_sentence != "",
      race_sentence != "",
      native_sentence != ""
    )
  
  
  paragraph_description <-
    paste0(
      
      opening_text,
      
      life_sentence,
      
      education_sentence,
      
      earnings_sentence,
      
      race_sentence,
      
      native_sentence,
      
      if (!has_any_stats) {
        paste0(data_unavailable_note, " ")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
    ) %>%
    
    str_squish()
  
  
  
  tibble(
    
    GEO_ID =
      as.character(
        x$GEO_ID[[1]]
      ),
    
    GEO_LABEL =
      as.character(
        x$GEO_LABEL[[1]]
      ),
    
    FULL_PLACE_NAME =
      blank_if_missing(
        x$FULL_PLACE_NAME[[1]]
      ),
    
    OPENING_DESCRIPTION =
      blank_if_missing(
        x$OPENING_DESCRIPTION[[1]]
      ),
    
    Paragraph_Description =
      paragraph_description
    
  )
  
}

# Generate descriptions for every NUCLEUS place 

list_of_places <-
  places %>%
  
  pull(
    GEO_ID
  ) %>%
  
  unique() %>%
  
  as.character()


place_summaries <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    list_of_places,
    generate_place_summary
  )


# QCs

expected_geo_ids <-
  sort(
    unique(
      places$GEO_ID
    )
  )


output_geo_ids <-
  sort(
    unique(
      place_summaries$GEO_ID
    )
  )


if (
  !identical(
    expected_geo_ids,
    output_geo_ids
  )
) {
  
  stop(
    
    "Geography mismatch after sentence generation. Missing: ",
    
    paste(
      setdiff(
        expected_geo_ids,
        output_geo_ids
      ),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    
    "; extra: ",
    
    paste(
      setdiff(
        output_geo_ids,
        expected_geo_ids
      ),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    
    call. = FALSE
    
  )
  
}



if (
  anyDuplicated(
    place_summaries$GEO_ID
  ) > 0
) {
  
  stop(
    "Duplicate GEO_ID values found in final output.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
  
}



if (
  nrow(place_summaries) !=
  nrow(places)
) {
  
  stop(
    "Final output row count does not match the NUCLEUS place list.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
  
}



blank_openings <- sum(
  
  is.na(
    place_summaries$OPENING_DESCRIPTION
  ) |
    
    place_summaries$OPENING_DESCRIPTION == ""
  
)


message(
  
  blank_openings,
  
  " NUCLEUS places have no City Descriptions opening sentence; ",
  "they were kept with a blank opening."
  
)



# Make sure output cannot overwrite an input/sorter file 

if (
  str_detect(
    str_to_lower(
      OUTPUT_PATH
    ),
    "sorter|nucleus"
  )
) {
  
  stop(
    paste0(
      "OUTPUT_PATH appears to target a sorter/NUCLEUS file. ",
      "Use a separate output filename."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
  
}



# Write final CSV 

write_csv(
  place_summaries,
  OUTPUT_PATH,
  na = ""
)


message(
  "Wrote: ",
  OUTPUT_PATH
)
